title: MAT Gemini Git Ops — bundle manifest
description: Machine-readable index for MAT-1. Executors MUST reject any op not listed here (deny-by-default).
notes: Orchestrator (Claude Code) never runs git; it only emits requests validated against request.schema.json.
Executor (e.g. Gemini CLI bridge) maps each op to an allowlisted argv template — no arbitrary shell.
MAT-11: optional request `timeout_ms` (1–86400000 ms); response may use `TIMEOUT` when the budget is exceeded.
